0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000010_TATARU
0.description: It's so much quieter these days without everyone around...

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000020_TATARU
1.description: ...Not that I'm pining for your return, you understand.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000030_TATARU
2.description: I have my sources, and I know that each and every one of you is doing well and keeping busy with your endeavors!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000040_TATARU
3.description: Meanwhile, I'm left with a surplus of free time─and the question of how to make the most of it!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000050_TATARU
4.description: What about you? Any plans for the immediate future?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
6.description: A grand new adventure, of course!

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000060_TATARU
9.description: Traveling to the edge of existence and back wasn't enough!? Well, if that's the case, I might have a suggestion for you...

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000070_TATARU
10.description: I hope you weren't thinking of asking <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> for advice! Though, if you <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> open to suggestions, I might have one for you...

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000080_TATARU
11.description: After what you went through, I'm not surprised you need a moment to think. But if you're open to suggestions, I might have one for you...

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000090_TATARU
12.description: You've fought bravely and selflessly, helping those in need and saving our star from unimaginable threats.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000100_TATARU
13.description: For your deeds, you've been hailed as the champion of Eorzea and a host of other incredible things. But why not put those titles aside for a while?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000110_TATARU
14.description: Acquit yourself as a simple adventurer again, and travel the world in search of wonder!

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
16.description: You're right! Who knows what mysteries are still waiting to be discovered?

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
17.description: That's a great idea. But where to start...?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000120_TATARU
19.description: That's the spirit! I can feel from here the blazing fire that just lit in your belly!

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000130_TATARU
20.description: Now all you need is a destination.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000135_TATARU
21.description: If you're having trouble deciding, just leave it to me.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000140_TATARU
22.description: Ahhh, with so many exciting places to choose from, it's hard to narrow it down...

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000150_TATARU
23.description: But I believe I have the perfect destination in mind.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000160_TATARU
24.description: If you're having trouble deciding, just leave it to me.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000170_TATARU
25.description: Thavnair─that's where you should go next!

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000180_TATARU
26.description: I doubt you were able to squeeze in a proper tour of Radz-at-Han the last time you were there, what with the burning skies and rampaging monsters and so forth. And I'm sure Vrtra would be pleased to see you!

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000190_TATARU
27.description: Then there's the Bounty itself. The Empire's presence in the region was always a deterrent to exploration, so if you've a mind to sail that sea, now's your chance.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000200_TATARU
28.description: Just think of all the new experiences you could have!

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000210_EMETSELCH
29.description: (-Emet-Selch-)Tell me, have you been to the ruins beneath the waters of the Bounty?

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000220_EMETSELCH
30.description: (-Emet-Selch-)As the bearer of Azem's crystal, you may consider your duty to see at least that much.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000230_TATARU
31.description: Oh, I know that look! That's an adventurer ready to take on the world!

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000240_TATARU
32.description: In anticipation of an occasion like this, I was planning to gift you a new set of traveling clothes, but it's, uh, still a work in progress.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000250_TATARU
33.description: Shouldn't take much longer now, though, so sit tight, and I'll have the last few bits sewn up before you can finish another cup of tea!

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000260_TATARU
37.description: Stitching here and trimming there, knot the threads with love and care...♪

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000270_TATARU
38.description: Just a little more to go! I'm sure you're still brimming with excitement!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000280_TATARU
39.description: Hee hee! I am one with the needle! See how the fabric surrenders to my whims!

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000290_TATARU
40.description: Don't worry, I'll make sure the lining has plenty of pockets for all your little “treasures.” I swear, adventurers are worse than children when it comes to hoarding every feather and leaf and animal hide they come across...

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000300_TATARU
41.description: Oh, we mustn't forget the waterproofing. Gods forbid you forget to disrobe before plunging into the sea. Or a river. Or a piping hot bath...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000330_TATARU
44.description: My apologies, I do get a little carried away with my sewing.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000340_TATARU
45.description: You seem awfully cheerful. Pleasant dream? Or are you just looking forward to the next chapter of your grand saga?

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000350_TATARU
46.description: Either way, I promised to provide you with new apparel, and so I shall!

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000360_TATARU
47.description: If you'll accompany me to the Diamond Forge, we can put the finishing touches on your outfit. Shall we?

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000370_MEHRAHD
48.description: (-Ragged Waif-)Please, Zasshal! Please! You must let me have that treasure map!

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000390_MEHRAHD
50.description: (-Ragged Waif-)My mother and father were slaughtered by monsters! My baby sister, still too young to fend for herself! Can you spare us no kindness!?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000400_ZASSHAL
51.description: So, you hope to find your fortune. And what? You expect me to surrender my wares for pity's sake?

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000410_ZASSHAL
52.description: What have you to offer in payment?

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000420_ZASSHAL
53.description: As I thought! Come back when you've more than rags to your name!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000430_ZASSHAL
54.description: This is no mere treasure map! It is a guide to the vaults of Alzadaal III─one of the great satraps of Radz-at-Han, and a direct descendant of Alzadaal Khan!

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000470_ZASSHAL
58.description: This is no fake! The parchment is marked with an arcane glyph of passage!

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000480_ZASSHAL
59.description: You may find the ruins hidden in the Bounty, but you won't be setting foot inside without this in your possession!

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000490_ZASSHAL
60.description: A priceless artifact, it is! Discovered amongst the rubble in the aftermath of the Final Days, and lovingly restored by yours truly!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000500_ZASSHAL
61.description: This map is the key to fabulous riches, and I would be the king of fools to simply <hex:021A020203>give<hex:021A020103> it away!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000510_ZASSHAL
62.description: Be glad I am no such king, boy─your scrawny hide would never return with that treasure alive!

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000530_MEHRAHD
64.description: (-Ragged Waif-)O cruel fate! Why must you tempt me with wealth I am powerless to claim!?

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000540_MEHRAHD
65.description: (-Ragged Waif-)How I shall envy the one who purchases that precious map! Whatever they pay will be but a pittance against the golden hoard they stand to uncover!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000550_ZASSHAL
66.description: What of you, sir? A fighting man of your stature would surely relish the challenge of recovering Alzadaal's lost fortune!

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000570_MEHRAHD
68.description: (-Ragged Waif-)If I had but the strength to seize that treasure, my starving sister would never want for food!

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000580_ESTINIEN
69.description: I'll take it. Will this cover the price?

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000610_ESTINIEN
72.description: But why Thavnair of all places? Knowing you, I suspect there is more to your plans than sightseeing and shopping.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000620_ESTINIEN
73.description: Ruins beneath the Bounty...? Curious. And here I've acquired a map to just such a site...

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000630_ZASSHAL
74.description: With that sale, I do believe I've earned the rest of the day off. Thank you for your patronage, sir, but if you'll excuse me...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000650_ZASSHAL
76.description: And now I've fleeced one of the heroes of the Final Days. I pray the Sisters were looking elsewhere...

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000660_ESTINIEN
77.description: This map may or may not be genuine. Either way, we'll need a ship to find out for sure.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
79.description: You seem eager to be underway.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
80.description: I never took you for a treasure hunter.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000670_ESTINIEN
81.description: Lest you misunderstand, I seek the treasure not for myself.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000680_ESTINIEN
82.description: If such a fortune truly exists, then it could help ease the struggles of those who lost their loved ones in the Final Days.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000690_ESTINIEN
83.description: I hope to do for Thavnair what you and Alphinaud did for the Ala Mhigans when you recovered the mad king's trove.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000700_ESTINIEN
84.description: Come now, you know Alphinaud needs little encouragement when it comes to recounting the tales of your shared exploits.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000710_ESTINIEN
85.description: Speaking of precocious lads, that boy in the bazaar was clearly an accomplice of the merchant.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000720_ESTINIEN
86.description: I suppose his role was to draw the attention of the crowd and add weight to the merchant's bold claims.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000730_ESTINIEN
87.description: A transparent act for the most part, but 'twas not all mummery─the need to provide for his sister rang true enough.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000740_ESTINIEN
88.description: Thus if some portion of the profits end up in that waif's pockets, then I will consider it money well spent...whether the map leads us to the vault or not.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000770_ESTINIEN
94.description: I appreciate the concern, but if there is one thing I've learned from my time with the Scions, it is how to better manage my coinpurse.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000780_ESTINIEN
95.description: Now, let's see about securing a vessel.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000790_GRAHATIA
96.description: I've never known Y'shtola to doze off in the middle of research before...

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000800_YSHTOLA
97.description: Mmm... I close my eyes for one moment...

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000820_YSHTOLA
99.description: How long have you two been here?

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
103.description: We didn't want to wake you.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
104.description: Catching up on some light reading?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000850_YSHTOLA
106.description: Nor did I want to fall asleep.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000870_YSHTOLA
108.description: I must have been studying for two...three days straight before exhaustion finally claimed me.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000880_YSHTOLA
109.description: As you know, I've been researching ways to travel from the Source to one of its reflections.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000890_YSHTOLA
110.description: Well...looking for hints, at least. I don't expect to find a simple set of instructions tucked away in some dark corner of the library.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000900_YSHTOLA
111.description: So I've been skimming through the stacks, hoping to uncover even a partial mention of any similar feats in the past.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000910_YSHTOLA
112.description: A means to travel between worlds exists, and you can be sure I will find a way to employ it...

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000920_YSHTOLA
113.description: So I promised Runar, but 'twould seem I've set myself a nigh-impossible task.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000930_GRAHATIA
114.description: You needn't be so hard on yourself.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000940_GRAHATIA
115.description: The leap I made with the Crystal Tower was not achieved in an afternoon─it was the culmination of a collective effort spanning generations.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000950_YSHTOLA
116.description: Oh, you think me discouraged? I assure you, 'tis quite the opposite.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000960_YSHTOLA
117.description: A daunting challenge and the time to sink my teeth into it? I feel like a fresh-faced student again.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000980_YSHTOLA
119.description: Indeed. Was there something else you wished to ask of me?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_000990_YSHTOLA
120.description: Alzadaal is no minor figure in Hannish history, and much is known about his family.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001000_YSHTOLA
121.description: But this is the first I've heard of a descendant surviving a trip to another world.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001010_YSHTOLA
122.description: If those tales are true, then he may have left behind some clue as to how it was accomplished.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001020_YSHTOLA
123.description: An invitation to delve into one of the world's lingering mysteries? As if I could refuse.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001030_YSHTOLA
124.description: And whence do we embark upon this expedition?

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001040_GRAHATIA
125.description: Akyaali, by ship─but before that, we thought to extend an invitation to Urianger as well. He was in Thaumazein, last we heard.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001050_YSHTOLA
126.description: Then by all means, let us recruit him and be on our way.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001090_GRAHATIA
130.description: I wish you had sent word ahead. I thought I was having visions for a moment there!

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
132.description: What are the two of you working on?

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
133.description: How is the restoration of the Students coming along?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001100_KRILE
134.description: Raha and I have been compiling old records of the Students' activities.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001110_KRILE
135.description: Slow and steady. Raha and I have been compiling old records of the Students' activities.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001120_KRILE
136.description: We were able to locate several accounts in the archives of Noumenon, but the bulk of our documents was lost along with the Isle of Val...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001130_KRILE
137.description: We located several accounts in the archives of Noumenon, and added them to the collection we recovered from the Isle of Val.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001140_GRAHATIA
138.description: And judging by the progress we've made thus far, sorting this pile will keep us occupied for days to come.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001150_GRAHATIA
139.description: But what brings you to the annex, my friend? Surely you haven't come all this way just to watch us shuffle dusty papers around?

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001160_GRAHATIA
140.description: The treasure vault of Alzadaal III...

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001170_KRILE
141.description: And you're looking for companions to join you on this expedition?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001180_KRILE
142.description: I would dearly love to accompany you, of course, but I'm afraid I'm committed to another task. On the subject of which, I had hoped to ask for your assistance...

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001191_KRILE
144.description: Then again, it's not so urgent that it can't wait until you've returned.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001200_KRILE
145.description: You should go, Raha. I'll stay here and mind the shop, as it were.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001210_GRAHATIA
146.description: Are you sure? I'd hate to leave you shorthanded...

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001220_KRILE
147.description: I'm sure. Just try to be back before <hex:021A020203>too<hex:021A020103> many moons have passed.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001230_GRAHATIA
148.description: Well! I guess we're off on another adventure already!

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001240_GRAHATIA
149.description: Have you asked anyone else to come along?

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001250_GRAHATIA
150.description: Then might I suggest we invite Y'shtola?

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001260_GRAHATIA
151.description: Ever since the Scions disbanded, she's spent most of her time cloistered within the Great Gubal Library, hoping to piece together a method to traverse the rift.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001270_GRAHATIA
152.description: It would seem, however, that whatever wisdom she sought there was not to be found. She arrived in Sharlayan the other day─we spoke briefly before she began her search of Noumenon.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001280_GRAHATIA
153.description: Considering what you've told us of Alzadaal's extraordinary feats, I do believe Y'shtola would be more than interested to hear what you have to say.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001290_GRAHATIA
154.description: Splendid. Then let us head to the archives at once.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001300_KRILE
155.description: Wait, before you go─I have another potential member to volunteer, if you've room to spare. Urianger.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001310_KRILE
156.description: He sent the Students a request for materials, you see─treatises on the architecture of treasure vaults and the like.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001320_KRILE
157.description: From what I can gather, the Loporrits are looking to make “improvements” to their own creation, and wish to learn more about how we build things down here.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001330_KRILE
158.description: From what I can gather, the Loporrits wish to build their own vault for the people of Etheirys to explore, and are looking for inspiration to help make it a “memorable” experience.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001340_KRILE
159.description: So why not take Urianger with you? Let him study Alzadaal's Legacy firsthand.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001350_GRAHATIA
160.description: None can deny the benefit of seeing something with your own eyes.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001360_GRAHATIA
161.description: If our expedition leader has no objections, I say we extend Urianger an invitation once we've spoken with Y'shtola.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001370_KRILE
162.description: Safe travels, you two. But don't forget: I'd still like your help with that other matter I mentioned.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001380_GRAHATIA
163.description: Right! Then it's off to the library!

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001410_URIANGER
166.description: Cloaked in the mantle of the common explorer, fame set aside in thy pursuit of simple adventure.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001420_URIANGER
167.description: I am told a new expedition is in the offing.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001430_URIANGER
171.description: And thee. As ever, thou art the picture of strength.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001440_URIANGER
172.description: He left to attend to some personal errand, but should be returning ere long.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001450_YSHTOLA
173.description: You've been keeping yourself busy, I trust?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001460_URIANGER
174.description: True to our plan, Thancred and I embarked upon a pilgrimage of sorts, with an eye for gauging the state of those lands through which we passed.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001470_URIANGER
175.description: Our travels were interrupted, however, by a request for aid from our befurred lunar allies.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001480_URIANGER
176.description: As you may recall, the Loporrits had been seeking new purpose for the moon─another role through which it might serve to benefit mankind. The Forum hath been working to advise them in this endeavor, but I returned to offer mine own counsel.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001490_GRAHATIA
177.description: And this has what to do with treasure vaults exactly...?

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001500_URIANGER
178.description: Ah, you have learned of my predicament from Mistress Krile.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001510_URIANGER
179.description: I know not whence they acquired such knowledge, but the Loporrits now stand convinced that adventurers delight in treasure hunts.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001520_URIANGER
180.description: Thus with their newly built “wonderland of riches and mystery” do they hope to entice all manner of daring delvers to the moon. So earnest and innocent was their desire to bring joy to the world that I found myself powerless to refuse them my cooperation...

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001530_URIANGER
181.description: But what of you, my friends? Why are you come to Labyrinthos?

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001540_URIANGER
182.description: Fascinating. This is, indeed, a most fortuitous opportunity.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001550_URIANGER
183.description: I should be honored to accept thine invitation.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001560_URIANGER
184.description: How long hath it been, I wonder, when last our actions were not impelled by fate or desperation?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001570_YSHTOLA
185.description: Aye, though I cherish the Scions' accomplishments, 'tis pleasant to not have the weight of the world upon our shoulders for a change.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001580_GRAHATIA
186.description: Counting Estinien, we number five now, yes? Without knowing what traps or perils await unwary feet, we may be wise to refrain from recruiting others.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001590_YSHTOLA
187.description: I agree. Between us, we should have the skills to handle whatever situation may arise. Shall we be on our way?

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001600_THANCRED
188.description: What, no time to spare a word for the grizzled old bard?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001620_THANCRED
190.description: A wasted trip, I'm afraid. I'd hoped to catch up with a former mentor while you parleyed with the rabbits, but it seems our paths were not to cross.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001630_THANCRED
194.description: That's because we didn't travel by experimental aetheryte. It's astounding what a lack of nausea does for one's sense of well-being.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001640_THANCRED
195.description: Having an astrologian beside you on the road is surprisingly convenient. And it doesn't hurt that he's making strides with his light-hearted banter.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001650_THANCRED
196.description: In any case, as we made our way around Ilsabard, we saw that much of the continent was in various stages of chaos.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001660_THANCRED
197.description: A certain amount of disorder is to be expected─the Final Days are over, and the people no longer have a common threat binding them together.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001670_THANCRED
198.description: But that's the thing with these fledgling troubles, eh? You need to keep an eye out lest they mature into full-grown headaches.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001680_THANCRED
199.description: So. For what reason have so many esteemed personages seen fit to gather?

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001690_THANCRED
200.description: Beneath the waters of the Bounty, you say? I see you've already stolen away my traveling partner with the promise of unexplored ruins and scholarly glory.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001700_URIANGER
201.description: Nay, 'tis not for mine own indulgence, but rather the fulfillment of my commitment to the Loporrits.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001710_THANCRED
202.description: Ah, of course... And if you have Estinien rounding out your group, you likely have all the members you need.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001720_YSHTOLA
203.description: Feeling left out? I could put in a good word for you, if you like.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001730_THANCRED
204.description: We may have been “released” from our obligations, but I'll never be free of that merciless wit of yours, will I?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001740_THANCRED
205.description: In all seriousness, 'tis best I sit this one out. Too many former Scions consorting with one another might be seen as a cause for concern in certain quarters.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001750_THANCRED
206.description: I'll return to my usual reconnaissance, and scout out the situation in the Far East. Feel free to share if you come across any interesting revelations.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001770_URIANGER
208.description: Shall we also hasten our departure? Ser Estinien will wonder what hath become of us.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001790_URIANGER
210.description: 'Tis not unlike a Hannish alchemical furnace in design...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001800_YSHTOLA
211.description: Well, there is one way we might find out...

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001820_GRAHATIA
213.description: Vrtra... Ah, my apologies. Should I continue calling you “Varshahn”?

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001830_VARSHAHN
214.description: You may address me as you wish. My nature is no longer a secret.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001840_VARSHAHN
215.description: Still, this is not the setting I imagined for our reunion. Surely you've not entered these ruins as common looters...?

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001850_ESTINIEN
216.description: Would that we could deny your accusations...but I fear you're not far from the truth.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001860_URIANGER
217.description: Great Vrtra. Might we beseech thee to explain the nature of this strange contrivance?

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001870_VARSHAHN
218.description: It was crafted by our alchemists at my behest. For the purpose of...sealing something away.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A9_000_002_NONE_VOICE
221.description: I wasn't going to touch it, but you know Y'shtola...

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001880_YSHTOLA
223.description: You and I will speak later.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001890_GRAHATIA
224.description: Not the time for frivolity, my friend, not the time...

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001900_URIANGER
225.description: This “something” of which thou speakest... Might it be some manner of threat?

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001910_URIANGER
226.description: This “something” of which thou speakest... Might it be some manner of threat?

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001920_VARSHAHN
227.description: Perhaps I should simply show you.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001930_VARSHAHN
228.description: I have lifted the seal, if only for the moment. By an authority only I possess.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001950_GRAHATIA
230.description: No, my friend... Small though it may be, this is a functioning gate into the void!

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001960_YSHTOLA
231.description: I must admit, I am deathly curious to know how a voidgate came to be hidden in the depths of these ruins.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001970_VARSHAHN
232.description: To tell that tale, we must first peer far to the south, and even further into memory.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001980_VARSHAHN
233.description: An age five millennia past, when the Allagan Empire sent an invading force to the shores of Meracydia.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_001990_VARSHAHN
234.description: The southern people rallied around the commanding figures of Bahamut and Tiamat, and fought fiercely to repel the would-be conquerors.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002000_VARSHAHN
235.description: With Bahamut's defeat, however, the tide turned against them. Desperate to seize any advantage, the Meracydians resorted to summoning primal entities.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002010_VARSHAHN
236.description: In response, Emperor Xande forged a covenant with the Cloud of Darkness, sovereign among the all-devouring denizens of the void.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002020_VARSHAHN
237.description: Thus bolstered by eikons on one side and voidsent on the other, the two armies clashed in a battle of unspeakable carnage. So much death. So much loss.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002030_GRAHATIA
238.description: I consider myself well versed in that period of history, yet you speak as one who witnessed it happen...

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002050_VARSHAHN
240.description: I heard Tiamat's roar of defiance, and sped toward that war-torn land...

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002070_VARSHAHN
242.description: We dragons are not “male” or “female” as men are wont to classify, but “elder sister” is the closest a mortal tongue can come to describing what she meant to me.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002080_VARSHAHN
243.description: I was the last of our brood to hatch, and Azdaja cared for me where my sire could not.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002090_VARSHAHN
244.description: Thus I was with her when Tiamat roared. I was with her when she journeyed south. And I was with her when she fought against the voidsent hordes.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002100_VARSHAHN
245.description: Yet no matter how many of their vile fiends we cast down, more rose from the abyss to take their place. Faced with an unwinnable war of attrition, Azdaja risked her all on a final gamble...

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002110_VARSHAHN
246.description: She plunged through the voidgate itself to strike at the root of their strength.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002120_VARSHAHN
247.description: I tried to follow in her wake, determined to lend what aid I could...but even as I came upon Allag's glittering tower, I saw the rift close behind her.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002130_VARSHAHN
248.description: And Azdaja has been lost to us ever since.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002140_GRAHATIA
249.description: I find I must retract my earlier claim of historical knowledge─nowhere in the Crystal Tower's archives did I see mention of such noble sacrifice.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002150_VARSHAHN
250.description: That does not surprise me. To Allagan eyes, it must have seemed as if a lone dragon, driven to madness, simply dove through the gate and did not return.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002160_VARSHAHN
251.description: For my part, I spent long years searching for the means to reunite with Azdaja...

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002170_VARSHAHN
252.description: Until I could search no more─until Allag was dust, and the arts to open a voidgate large enough to accommodate a dragon forever lost.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002180_YSHTOLA
253.description: Yet you have the beginnings of a gate right here, under the control of a Hannish device.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002190_VARSHAHN
254.description: My discovery came before Radz-at-Han was founded. Though I scoured the lands for a method to cross the rift, it was beneath the sea that I chanced to find a natural planar fissure.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002200_VARSHAHN
255.description: It was, however, far too narrow to admit a wyrm's bulk. Only after our city rose upon the rock, and I could enlist the aid of our talented alchemists, did matters take a favorable turn.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002210_VARSHAHN
256.description: Their dedication was beyond reproach. Tirelessly they worked to expand the fissure, and after decades of toil, it finally grew to a size that a child might pass through...

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002220_ESTINIEN
257.description: Not long ago, you told us that you called out to your kin; that Azdaja's answer was silence. I suspect the conclusion to your tale is not a joyful one.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002230_VARSHAHN
258.description: With hope in my heart, I used a simulacrum to cross the threshold...but no─I did not find her.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002240_VARSHAHN
259.description: What I found was a host of voidsent, clamoring around the opening they had sensed.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002250_VARSHAHN
260.description: 'Twas but a moment, but enough. I had no choice but to retreat and allow the portal to contract once more.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002260_ESTINIEN
261.description: The gate was a threat to your people. You had to decide between endangering Radz-at-Han, and abandoning your sister... And you chose the latter.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002270_URIANGER
262.description: 'Twas not that thy sibling scorned thy call; 'twas that she was trapped beyond a barrier through which neither roar nor dragon may pass. Even now, in the desolate world of the Thirteenth...

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002280_GRAHATIA
263.description: I can scarce imagine your pain, yet it was wise not to linger in that place. Too long a sojourn, and even a being of your power risks being warped into a creature of the void.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002290_GRAHATIA
264.description: You've seen this phenomenon before, when we stepped into the darkness...

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A10_000_001_NONE_VOICE
266.description: Aye, I thought our time had come.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A10_000_002_NONE_VOICE
267.description: I remember when Nero turned purple...

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002300_GRAHATIA
269.description: As did I. Were it not for Unei and Doga─or Nero, for that matter─we might never have made it home.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002310_GRAHATIA
270.description: Do you remember what happened to Nero? How his wounds allowed the void's corruption to enter his body and twist his aether?

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002320_GRAHATIA
271.description: Turn purple? Well, yes, his wounds had allowed the void's corruption to enter his body and twist his aether.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002330_GRAHATIA
272.description: Remember well what happened to Nero, when his wounds allowed the void's corruption to enter his body and twist his aether...

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002340_GRAHATIA
273.description: Had it been allowed to progress much longer, I presume he would've been fully transformed.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002350_VARSHAHN
274.description: Then there is little hope for Azdaja...

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002360_GRAHATIA
275.description: Ah, no, I hadn't meant to─ I speak only of possibilities.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002370_GRAHATIA
276.description: The scales of the first brood are extraordinarily resistant to aetherial fluctuations. They are the protective talismans' core components, after all, and even the corruption I described would struggle to overcome─

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002380_GRAHATIA
277.description: Of course. With a warding scale in one's possession, one could conceivably survive a stay in the Thirteenth without being warped by its energies...

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002390_VARSHAHN
278.description: Be that as it may, it is too late to rescue my sister. Five thousand years too late.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002400_VARSHAHN
279.description: And now, countless others look to me for guidance and protection.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002410_VARSHAHN
280.description: So when I sensed intruders in the ruins, I came only to ensure that the gate remain closed. That, and to secure the treasure, of course.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002420_VARSHAHN
281.description: I wish only to forget the rest...

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002430_VRITRA
282.description: I thank you for your attendance.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002440_VRITRA
283.description: The riches the Radiant Host have retrieved were hoarded in Alzadaal's name─a fortune I set aside for a future day of need.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002450_VRITRA
284.description: And lo, that day hath come. May it aid our wounded city in reclaiming its vibrancy and vigor!

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002460_VRITRA
285.description: In better times, I would leave such a task to our capable Ahewann, gods rest his soul.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002470_VRITRA
286.description: Finding myself bereft of his counsel in the here and now, I will assume the responsibilities of mine office directly.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002480_VRITRA
287.description: Firstly, the treasure shall be sold for more convenient currency, thence invested into the trading port of Yedlihmad. Our merchants must have their operations restored, their ships rebuilt. Commerce must flow once more!

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002490_VRITRA
288.description: None were spared the tragedy of the Final Days─of this I am well aware.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002500_VRITRA
289.description: But an absence was created by the loss of Khalzahl's consortium, and by filling it, we provide new means for our fishermen, our artisans, and others to bring their wares to distant markets.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002510_ESTINIEN
290.description: And what of the children who were left without family to care for them?

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002520_VRITRA
291.description: That is a concern which weigheth heavily upon my mind. A simple gift of coin will soon be exhausted, leaving these young souls adrift on the fringes of our society.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002530_VRITRA
292.description: Nay, a proper solution is needed, one which doth guarantee their welfare for years to come.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002540_VRITRA
293.description: Thou hast surely seen how other nations rise to meet this challenge, adventurer. What dost thou deem the wisest course?

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A11_000_001_NONE_VOICE
295.description: Taxes. Levy them on trade profits in exchange for your investment.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A11_000_003_NONE_VOICE
297.description: Idyllshire's orphanage was funded through trade in highly coveted goods...

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A11_000_004_NONE_VOICE
298.description: The Firmament's orphanage was built as part of a communal restoration effort.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002550_VRITRA
299.description: I see... We create a reliable source of revenue.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002560_VRITRA
300.description: Of course... We must all look out for one another.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002570_VRITRA
301.description: Of course... We can draw on trading profits to build a new institution.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002580_VRITRA
302.description: Of course... The revival of trade can contribute to the building of a new institution.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002590_VRITRA
303.description: Let us put this idea into practice. A contract shall be written, requiring all who receive of Alzadaal's treasure to commit a portion of their future earnings towards the running of an orphanage.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002610_VRITRA
305.description: Now, such an influential policy is deserving of a worthy name...

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A12_000_002_NONE_VOICE
308.description: Why not honor one of your most successful merchants?

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002630_VRITRA
310.description: A successful merchant...? Ah, I believe I see thy reasoning.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002640_VRITRA
311.description: Khalzahl should be remembered not as the blasphemy which terrorized Thavnair, but as a hardworking and generous man who brought much wealth to our shores.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002650_VRITRA
312.description: Do any among you object to this proposition? Many here lost loved ones to the beasts...

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002660_NAHBDEEN
313.description: In that time of strife, any one of us could have broken. Any one of us may have been taken by despair.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002670_NAHBDEEN
314.description: When I think of Khalzahl, I feel no hatred...only a stinging regret that we could not save him as well.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002690_ESTINIEN
316.description: This bodes well for that boy─“Mehrahd,” was it? Perhaps he can cut ties with that shady peddler.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002700_VRITRA
317.description: Then let it be done. Henceforth, this initiative shall be known as the “Khalzahl Foundation”!

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002710_VRITRA
318.description: Nahbdeen, thou art to assemble a patrol, and ensure that no child in this city liveth in squalor!

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002720_VRITRA
319.description: Clerks! See to the management of our funds and make haste! Our citizens must not suffer a day more than is necessary!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002730_ESTINIEN
320.description: Dragon and man, side by side in pursuit of a brighter morrow. I'm reminded of Ishgard.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002760_YSHTOLA
323.description: I took a closer look at that device. I was able to determine how it keeps the voidgate sealed, but not how it might instead be employed to expand the opening.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002770_YSHTOLA
324.description: For that, I would need to reference the technique developed by Vrtra's alchemists─no records of which appear to have survived the intervening years.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002780_ESTINIEN
325.description: We know this, so why have you sent for us? Have you learned aught of value or not?

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002790_YSHTOLA
326.description: Patience, good ser─one must introduce the subject before launching into specifics.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002800_YSHTOLA
327.description: From what we understand, travel between worlds is accomplished by passing through the nebulous rift which exists between them.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002810_YSHTOLA
328.description: Picture, if you will, the moment you were called to the First.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002820_YSHTOLA
329.description: You touched a focus of some kind to help the Exarch pinpoint your location. His summoning spell then channeled the energies of the Crystal Tower to begin your journey to his world.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002830_YSHTOLA
330.description: The magicks tore a hole in the wall separating Source and shard, and cast you into the intervening nothingness.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002840_YSHTOLA
331.description: In that place, the laws of nature hold no sway...

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002850_YSHTOLA
332.description: Yet even through this realm of temporal and spatial instability, you were borne safely to your destination in the First.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002860_YSHTOLA
333.description: The feat that guided you across such an unimaginable distance─both physical and metaphorical─was nothing short of a miracle.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002870_ESTINIEN
334.description: Then what of the many voidsent found in the Source? Who guides them here, and how?

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002890_YSHTOLA
336.description: Though there are several methods by which the void's denizens might intrude upon our world, the rituals of summoning are the most typical.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002900_YSHTOLA
337.description: For example, let us consider the gargoyle─a creature of middling power.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002910_YSHTOLA
338.description: To call upon such an entity, the prospective summoner must force open a voidgate.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002920_YSHTOLA
339.description: The portal lasts but a moment and is relatively small, allowing only an imp or other lesser being to squeeze through with their physical body intact.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002930_YSHTOLA
340.description: Our more powerful gargoyle, however, is too large for that. Creating a gate big enough for him would require vast amounts of energy─far beyond the reserves of any one mortal practitioner.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002940_YSHTOLA
341.description: Instead, 'tis far more common to bring over only the entity's soul. We had a taste of that ourselves when a certain Exarch dragged us to the First.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002950_YSHTOLA
342.description: And just as our bodies remained in our world, the voidsent's physical form is left behind in the Thirteenth.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002960_YSHTOLA
343.description: Once at its destination, the summoned soul is granted a temporary shell to inhabit. In the gargoyle's case, a stone effigy has proven a suitable vessel.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002970_ESTINIEN
344.description: Wait─you said that voidsent must be called here deliberately by someone in the Source─reeled in like a fisherman with his catch?

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002980_YSHTOLA
345.description: Exactly. For a being to navigate the chaos of the rift, with or without form, there must needs be a guiding agent on the other side.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_002990_VARSHAHN
346.description: When the hordes poured forth from Allag's great gate, it was the technologists who drew them through.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003000_VARSHAHN
347.description: Though to my knowledge, planar fissures are, in essence, natural passages between our world and the void, which require no such guidance to traverse.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003010_VARSHAHN
348.description: Why is only the boundary between the Source and the Thirteenth so fragile? So much so that it often tears open of its own accord...

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003020_YSHTOLA
349.description: I believe solving that mystery is key to understanding travel between the Source and its reflections.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003030_ESTINIEN
350.description: And how do you intend to get your answers?

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003050_YSHTOLA
352.description: Perhaps. But what some call “danger,” others think of as “adventure.”

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003060_VARSHAHN
353.description: Were you not listening to my tale? Never mind that the means to expand the gate has been lost to the ages.

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003070_VARSHAHN
354.description: Even could you force the portal wide enough, you would be greeted by an army of murderous horrors the very instant you stepped through.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003080_YSHTOLA
355.description: I assure you I was most attentive. And I agree that to go alone would be certain death.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003090_YSHTOLA
356.description: But if I were to bring along one who has already braved the Thirteenth and humbled the Cloud of Darkness─well, I imagine my chances would be much improved.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A13_000_002_NONE_VOICE
359.description: So much for taking it easy.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003100_YSHTOLA
360.description: I had a feeling you might say that.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003110_YSHTOLA
361.description: Once again, I put my life in your ever-reliable hands.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003120_YSHTOLA
362.description: Since when were you one for the quiet life?

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003130_YSHTOLA
363.description: Once again, I put my life in your ever-reliable hands.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003140_YSHTOLA
364.description: That said, as much as I would like to march straight back to the voidgate, there is the small matter of being unable to open it without the satrap's personal authority...

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003150_VARSHAHN
365.description: As I've said before, I will grant you and yours any boon you choose to name...provided it does not endanger my people.

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003160_YSHTOLA
366.description: You have my word that we will take every precaution─not a single voidsent will be allowed to threaten Radz-at-Han. Assuming we manage to expand the portal in the first place...

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003180_YSHTOLA
368.description: Actually, I had hoped you might help us with that. I presume the alchemists you retained supplied you with some explanation of their methodology?

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003190_VARSHAHN
369.description: That they did. House Daemir was overseeing the project...

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003200_YSHTOLA
370.description: Daemir, Daemir... Ah, yes, the family associated with the Great Work.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003210_VARSHAHN
371.description: I did not fully comprehend the theory, but their research began with a voidsent which had slipped through the fissure.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003220_VARSHAHN
372.description: After a thorough examination, they created an arcane simulacrum possessed of similar qualities. A man-made voidsent, if you will. It was apparently indispensable in their efforts to enlarge the gate.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003240_VARSHAHN
374.description: Yes. Being great admirers of the Archons, House Daemir submitted detailed notes to Sharlayan's official committee. They expected praise and accolades for their simulacrum...and were thus devastated to be informed that their work had been classified as prohibited material.

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003250_YSHTOLA
375.description: If that's true, then those notes might still be stored in a forbidden archive somewhere. Not Gubal, of course, since that library had yet to be built. Which leaves us with...

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A14_000_001_NONE_VOICE
377.description: With the restricted section of Noumenon?

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A14_000_002_NONE_VOICE
378.description: With G'raha's favorite place to sneak around.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003260_YSHTOLA
380.description: Yes, it may very well hold a copy.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003270_YSHTOLA
381.description: Indeed. Noumenon's restricted stacks may very well hold a copy.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003280_YSHTOLA
382.description: Have you already forgotten G'raha's debacle in Noumenon?

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003290_YSHTOLA
383.description: ...The restricted section where he was caught sneaking about? It may very well hold a copy of the Daemirs' documentation.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003300_YSHTOLA
384.description: In which case, I say we head directly to Sharlayan.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003310_ESTINIEN
385.description: Unless you anticipate needing help to reach the high shelves, I see myself being of little use. Go on ahead. I still need to find Mehrahd and tell him about the Khalzahl Foundation.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003320_YSHTOLA
386.description: Let us be on our way, as well.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003330_VARSHAHN
387.description: They are resolved to venture into the void. Do I sit idly by...?

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003340_YSHTOLA
388.description: If House Daemir's notes are to be found anywhere, it will be here. Let us begin.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003350_YSHTOLA
389.description: Yes, the aether signature is unmistakable. I've felt the traces of House Daemir's resonance many times at the Great Work.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003360_YSHTOLA
390.description: Time to see what all the fuss was about...

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003370_YSHTOLA
391.description: “Among the ranks of the voidsent, there exist entities with the power to call forth their brethren from beyond. The species known as ”Atomos,“ however, is uniquely prodigious in this regard.

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003380_YSHTOLA
392.description: “From its distended maw, it can expel an endless procession of voidborn creatures─a talent which sorely tested the Radiant Host in its battles against these abominations.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003390_YSHTOLA
393.description: “Surmising that the entity itself was acting as a voidgate, we endeavored to capture a small specimen and subsequently examine its physiological structure.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003400_YSHTOLA
394.description: “Our findings revealed that the Atomos had absorbed a planar fissure into its own flesh, which it could expand at will into a functioning gate.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003410_YSHTOLA
395.description: “Upon further analysis, we identified an aetherial wave pattern emitted during this process─a pattern we were able to emulate by passing crystal-stored aether through a specially designed prism.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003420_YSHTOLA
396.description: “We proceeded to embed said prism into an arcane simulacrum, thus completing what we have dubbed our 'artificial Atomos.'”

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003430_YSHTOLA
397.description: How could I have been so blind to the possibilities? This species, not to mention its ability to summon voidsent, has been discussed among academics for years now.

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003440_YSHTOLA
398.description: Just before the advent of the Seventh Umbral Calamity, we received reports of Atomos sightings from every corner of Eorzea. Surely you witnessed an appearance yourself in the course of your travels?

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003450_YSHTOLA
399.description: Just before the advent of the Seventh Umbral Calamity, we received reports of Atomos sightings from every corner of Eorzea. Surely you've at least heard the tales?

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003460_YSHTOLA
400.description: And still House Daemir went and built a mock Atomos of their very own. I'm not surprised the Archons consigned their work to a restricted archive.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003470_YSHTOLA
401.description: 'Twas no easy task, but at last we've unearthed the volume we've been searching for.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003480_YSHTOLA
402.description: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't tempted to stay longer. See what other forbidden titles might be lurking on these shelves...

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003490_YSHTOLA
403.description: Ah, but that would be abusing the very special privilege we've been granted now, wouldn't it? Better not.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003500_NIDHANA
404.description: The ruins alone were impressive enough, but I never dreamed such a treasure lay hidden in the depths of the Bounty...

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003510_NIDHANA
405.description: It may have been helpful to know this device existed, Your Excellency.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003520_VARSHAHN
406.description: My apologies...the gate was a secret I shared with none but my closest advisors. I feared for what might happen should those with ill intentions learn of its existence.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003530_ESTINIEN
407.description: What is it you're doing now?

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003540_YSHTOLA
408.description: There is something I wish to verify.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003550_YSHTOLA
409.description: The NOAH reports claim that a short stint into the void carries little risk of aetheric imbalance.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003560_YSHTOLA
410.description: Should one suffer an injury, however, or if one's expedition drags on longer than intended, that risk becomes significantly greater.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003570_YSHTOLA
411.description: G'raha theorized that a warding scale would confer protection from the void's corrupting influence... But I would prefer to test that hypothesis before we set foot in the Thirteenth ourselves.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003580_ESTINIEN
412.description: So...this is an experiment of sorts.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003590_YSHTOLA
413.description: Yes. An experiment... Tell me: how would <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> go about testing the efficacy of the warding scale?

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A15_000_002_NONE_VOICE
416.description: (Say nothing and look meaningfully at Estinien.)

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003600_ESTINIEN
418.description: And how would you do that? The gate is still too small for any of us to pass through.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003610_YSHTOLA
419.description: Estinien is correct. Which is why I've elected to send a familiar in our stead.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003620_ESTINIEN
420.description: What? Why are you looking at me like that? Surely you'd not expect me to wriggle through that tiny portal?

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003630_YSHTOLA
421.description: We needn't attempt anything so drastic. A small familiar should serve well enough.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003640_YSHTOLA
422.description: Very good. I see you've been paying attention.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003650_YSHTOLA
423.description: As Vrtra sent his simulacrum, so too shall we rely on a familiar to bear the brunt of any unpleasant consequences.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003660_YSHTOLA
424.description: Now, a lowly imp can navigate a fissure, no matter how narrow.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003670_YSHTOLA
425.description: Which means an arcane entity of similar stature should be able to manage the same.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003680_YSHTOLA
426.description: I hadn't wanted it to come to this...but no other familiars will do, I'm afraid.

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003690_ESTINIEN
427.description: I mislike the sound of that. What manner of fiend does she mean to summon...?

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003700_YSHTOLA
428.description: From ocean rise and cloudbank form,<hex:02100103>From mountain spring and rainfall storm,<hex:02100103>From river flow and life be born...

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003720_ESTINIEN
430.description: Ready your arms. I fear she's been possessed...

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003730_NIDHANA
431.description: Oh, come now, that was adorable!

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003740_NOKKEN
432.description: Water, water, froth and foam!♪<hex:02100103>Time to play!

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003750_YSHTOLA
433.description: Though not my first choice, these familiars I conceived of as a child have the best chance of fitting through the gate.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003760_YSHTOLA
434.description: ...I only wish my younger self had considered a more dignified ending to the creation ritual.

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003770_YSHTOLA
435.description: In any case, these two should serve us well.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003780_YSHTOLA
436.description: This one will bear a warding scale...

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003790_YSHTOLA
437.description: And when they return from the Thirteenth, we can observe how the talisman─or absence thereof─has affected the progress of the void's corruption.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003800_YSHTOLA
438.description: If I could impose upon you to open the gate, Your Excellency?

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003820_YSHTOLA
440.description: We should also be wary of voidsent slipping through while we conduct our experiment. Estinien, you are to keep Nidhana safe from harm.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003840_YSHTOLA
442.description: You had best be on your guard, as well.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003850_YSHTOLA
447.description: And we are glad for it.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003860_YSHTOLA
448.description: Oh? Are you volunteering to join the nixies? I could shrink you down, you know...

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003870_YSHTOLA
449.description: Please, just...do me a favor, and forget you ever saw that.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003900_NOKKEN
452.description: Water, water, froth and foam! Into shadowed realms we roam!

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003910_YSHTOLA
453.description: I think we've waited long enough.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003940_YSHTOLA
456.description: Thank you, little one. You did well.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003950_NIDHANA
457.description: The poor thing. Its essence has been irrevocably warped...

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_003970_VOIDSENTB
459.description: I cannot die... I WANT to die... Kill me... END ME...

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004000_VARSHAHN
462.description: We're out of time! I must reseal the voidgate!

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004020_VARSHAHN
464.description: In the name of Alzadaal III... I bar this door unto the void!

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004030_NIDHANA
465.description: Well, that was a sharp lesson in the dangers of voidgates...

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004040_ESTINIEN
466.description: And what of our experiment? I'd say the results speak for themselves.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004050_YSHTOLA
467.description: The unprotected nixie has suffered extensive aetheric corruption. As Nidhana observed, it's well on its way to becoming a voidsent.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004060_YSHTOLA
468.description: The one merged with the talisman, however, appears unaffected. I sense no changes to its equilibrium.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004090_YSHTOLA
471.description: So it would seem. But while our second familiar was untouched by void energies, the talisman itself shows signs of degradation.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004100_YSHTOLA
472.description: It was, of course, originally designed to shield the soul from primal tempering─it stands to reason that aetheric corruption of a different sort would affect it differently.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004110_YSHTOLA
473.description: We may need to modify the warding scale's design to account for the Thirteenth's uniquely unstable aether...

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004120_ESTINIEN
474.description: You've said much of the void's instability, but my imagination fails me. What manner of place is this broken world?

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004130_YSHTOLA
475.description: Ah, my apologies. I forget that not all of us spend our days sequestered in dusty archives.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004140_YSHTOLA
476.description: The Thirteenth is a reflection of the Source that was drowned in a flood of Darkness.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004150_YSHTOLA
477.description: In Emet-Selch's own words, this tragedy was a result of the Ascians' attempts to force a Rejoining. They erred in their haste, and made of that world a “useless void.”

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004160_YSHTOLA
478.description: You remember Unukalhai, the unusual child we met during our troubles with the Warring Triad? He explained the fate of the Thirteenth thus:

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004170_YSHTOLA
479.description: The champions of that ill-fated world used the stone known as “auracite” to contain the power of primals.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004180_YSHTOLA
480.description: But those selfsame heroes were gradually corrupted by the auracite's bleeding energies, transforming into fiends with an endless hunger for aether.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004190_YSHTOLA
481.description: By the time anyone thought to oppose them, Light's strength had grown too feeble...and the balance of the Thirteenth tipped into eternal Darkness.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004200_YSHTOLA
482.description: It was Elidibus, as I recall, who rescued Unukalhai's spirit from his final battlefield.

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004210_YSHTOLA
483.description: But I wonder if there were others whom the emissary saved from oblivion...

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A17_000_001_NONE_VOICE
485.description: The barmaid at the Wandering Stairs...

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004220_YSHTOLA
487.description: The server...Cyella, wasn't it? And you say she was another of Elidibus's pawns?

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004230_YSHTOLA
488.description: Cylva? The adventurer who traveled with the Warriors of Light? And you say she was another of Elidibus's pawns?

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004240_YSHTOLA
489.description: I see... So Cyella, or rather, Cylva, was beguiled by the same dreams of heroism as Unukalhai.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004250_YSHTOLA
490.description: And what of your own experience? Will you tell us of what you observed during NOAH's expedition?

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004260_YSHTOLA
491.description: I can picture it now... The sunless, stygian expanse, infested with legions of aether-starved monstrosities. A void in every sense of the word.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004270_VARSHAHN
492.description: What you have described in such lurid detail is exactly why I hesitate to encourage you.

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004280_YSHTOLA
493.description: Worry not, great Vrtra─our journey into the Thirteenth is but the first leg of a longer voyage.

494.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004290_YSHTOLA
494.description: A voyage that shall lead us to other reflections─to new mysteries and discoveries─and I mean to be there every step of the way.

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004300_YSHTOLA
495.description: But first I must focus on refining the warding talisman...

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004310_NIDHANA
496.description: Then I can begin work on constructing an artificial Atomos.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004320_NIDHANA
497.description: Or, I could if I had the relevant manuals to hand. Might I be so bold as to request access to the satrap's family archives?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004340_VARSHAHN
499.description: Hm...? Oh! Yes, that can be arranged. I will speak to my officials upon our return.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004350_NIDHANA
500.description: We will see you back in the city, then!

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004360_NIDHANA
501.description: Ah, Y'shtola! The adjustments are going well, I hope?

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004370_YSHTOLA
502.description: 'Tis a lengthy process, but the end is in sight, yes.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004380_NIDHANA
503.description: That's wonderful news! I, myself, had some good fortune searching through the satrap's private records.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004390_NIDHANA
504.description: What I found was a transaction log, dated around the same period as when Alzadaal's Legacy was built. It included a purchase list of highly exclusive alchemical components...and I knew I'd discovered the key to making the artificial Atomos.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004400_NIDHANA
505.description: I then visited the High Crucible to commission the materials. After I'd explained my requirements, I was beset by volunteers insisting I allow them to help with the entire project!

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004410_YSHTOLA
506.description: The usual reaction to someone forcing open a voidgate is to run for the hills... Hannish academics certainly are a different breed.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004420_VARSHAHN
507.description: The alchemists of old were cut from a similar cloth. The unknown held no fear for them─indeed, they were ever eager to seek new knowledge, regardless of the danger.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004430_YSHTOLA
508.description: And were you not also fearless─heedless, even─in your determination?

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004440_VARSHAHN
509.description: ...My sire entered his dormancy before I was hatched. And so it was Azdaja who kept my egg safe and warm.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004450_VARSHAHN
510.description: It created a bond between us. Even long after I learned to fend for myself, I rarely strayed from her side.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004460_VARSHAHN
511.description: She was my guardian, my sister, my dear companion...and not a single day passes that I do not mourn her absence.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004470_VARSHAHN
512.description: No matter how deep the darkness, I would not surrender my search. I promised myself the time would come when we would once more take to the skies together.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004490_NAHBDEEN
514.description: The Radiant Host is here to serve, Your Excellency!

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004510_NAHBDEEN
516.description: Ser Estinien told us of your predicament.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004520_NAHBDEEN
517.description: For centuries you have protected Radz-at-Han, never showing your true self. Hiding behind a curtain, and living only in service to the people...

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004530_NAHBDEEN
518.description: Your dedication meant more to us than your deceit, and so did we accept you as our rightful ruler.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004540_NAHBDEEN
519.description: After all that you have sacrificed for this nation, did you imagine we would begrudge you your heart's desire?

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004550_NAHBDEEN
520.description: We survived the Final Days. We are a strong and proud people. We, the Radiant Host, will keep Thavnair safe in your absence!

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004560_VARSHAHN
521.description: I am grateful for your loyalty, and for your encouragement. And yet...

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004570_NAHBDEEN
522.description: Now, you listen to me, Varshahn!

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004580_NAHBDEEN
523.description: You are wearing that face, after all.

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004590_NAHBDEEN
524.description: As I have told you before, you are a little brother to us all.

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004600_NAHBDEEN
525.description: And if you are family, then so, too, is your sister.

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004610_NAHBDEEN
526.description: We are there for you if you need us. But do not ask us to sit by and watch while you abandon a sibling you have ached to rescue for millennia!

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004620_NIDHANA
527.description: We <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> succeed in opening the way─it is only a matter of time! All you need do is prepare to step through to the other side!

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004630_MEHRAHD
528.description: Your Excellency... I wanted to thank you for building the orphanage. It means so much that my sister and I will have a place to be together, safe and happy.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004640_MEHRAHD
529.description: And I hope that you and your sister can be together again, too!

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A18_000_001_NONE_VOICE
531.description: To protect them well, you must take heart.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_A18_000_002_NONE_VOICE
532.description: Will you wallow in uncertainty forever...?

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004660_VARSHAHN
534.description: Such were the words I once said to you. And here I stand, failing to live up to them.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004670_VARSHAHN
535.description: If my heart is torn, I am fit to protect neither Azdaja, nor Radz-at-Han.

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004680_VARSHAHN
536.description: You're saying I should seize this chance?

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004690_VARSHAHN
537.description: “Take heart, and protect them well.” Such were the words I once said to you. And here I stand, failing to live up to them.

538.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004700_VARSHAHN
538.description: If my heart is torn, I am fit to protect neither Azdaja, nor Radz-at-Han.

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004710_VARSHAHN
539.description: My people, I have come to a decision. Varshahn will depart Thavnair for a time.

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004720_VARSHAHN
540.description: My dragon self will remain in the palace, but only to conduct the satrap's most essential duties.

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004730_VARSHAHN
541.description: While I am focused on controlling this vessel, there may be matters that escape my attention.

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004740_VARSHAHN
542.description: I rely on you, my trusted friends, to watch over one another until I return.

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004750_NAHBDEEN
543.description: Take care and fair fortune, little brother. Many tears would be shed should you come to harm.

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004760_VARSHAHN
544.description: I would not dare make you cry.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06100_004780_MYSTERIOUSPERSON
547.description: To this world bereft of saviors...
